audience: marketers who send email newsletters with iContact

useCases.title: Check the size of our mailing lists and unsubscribes
useCases.text: Lists the mailing lists and the list memberships by status, so you can count subscribed and unsubscribed contacts per list.

useCases.title: Check the results of a message
useCases.text: Reads a message's released, bounce, open, click, unsubscribe and complaint numbers, and lists who opened, clicked or bounced.

useCases.title: Review sends and saved segments
useCases.text: Lists sends with their message, included and excluded lists, scheduled time and status, and lists the saved segments.

useCases.title: Look up a contact
useCases.text: Finds contacts by exact email, name, status or list, and shows email, name, address, phone and status.

useCases.title: Add a contact and subscribe them to a list
useCases.text: Creates a contact, then puts them on a list, directly or with double opt-in. Use it only for people who agreed to get email.

useCases.title: Update a contact or unsubscribe them
useCases.text: Changes fields of a contact, stops mail to them with a status such as do not contact, or unsubscribes them from a list.
